New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2023 


S.O. 54(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH548B in 
the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 02.3l0 (Murrum to Vijayapur Section) in the district of Kalaburagi 
(Gulbarga ) in the state of KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Assistant Commissioner, Indi in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

New Delhi, the 25th January, 2023 


S.O. 510(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH166E in 
the stretch of land from Km 0.00 to Km 23.310 (Tikota-Bijjaragi-Kanamadi MH-Border Section) in the district of 
Vijayapur in the state of KARNATAKA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this notification in 
the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of section 3C of the 
said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Assistant Commissioner 
Vijayapur in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

NOTIFICATION 

New Delhi , the 2nd February , 2023 

S.O. 506 ( E ) .– Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways , S.O. 1484 ( E ) dated 30.03.2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the schedule annexed to the said notification for building ( four / Six - laning , etc. , ) , maintenance , management and 
operation from Km.199.000 to Km.215.000 of new greenfield access controlled economic corridor starting at 
Kodikonda check - post on NH - 44 ( near KN / AP border ) and terminating at its junction near Addanki on NH - 16 in the 
district on the stretch of SPS Nellore in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Sakshi ” and “ Deccan Chronicle " 
both dated 06.04.2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


[ भाग II— खण्ड 3 ( ii ) ] 

9 

And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का.आ. 541 ( अ ) . – जबकि , भारत सरकार को लोकहित में यह आवष्यक प्रतीत होता है कि झारखण्ड राज्य में 
जगदीशपुर - हल्दिया - बोकारो - धामरा प्राकृतिक गैस पाइपलाइन के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक गैस के परिवहन के लिए 
गेल ( इण्डिया ) लिमिटेड द्वारा एक पाइपलाइन बिछाई जानी चाहिए । 


और भारत सरकार को उक्त पाइप लाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए यह आवष्यक प्रतीत होता है कि उक्त 
भूमि में , जिसमें उक्त पाइप लाइन बिछाए जाने का प्रस्ताव है और जो इस अधिसूचना में संलग्न अनुसूची में वर्णित है , 
उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन किया जाए । 


अतः अब , भारत सरकार , पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइप लाइन ( भूमि में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन ) 
अधिनियम , 1962 ( 1962 का 50 ) कि धारा 3 कि उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त षक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , उस भूमि में 
उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने के अपने आषय की घोषणा करती हैं । 


कोई व्यक्ति , जो उक्त अनुसूची में वर्णित भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उस तारीख से जिसको उक्त अधिनियम की 
धारा 3 की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन भारत के राजपत्र में यथा प्रकाषित इस अधिसूचना की प्रतियां साधारण जनता को 
उपलब्ध कर दी जाती है , 21 दिन के भीतर , भूमि के नीचे पाइप लाइन बिछाए जाने की संबंध में सक्षम प्राधिकारी , 
गेल ( इण्डिया ) लिमिटेड , रांची को लिखित रूप में आक्षेप भेज सकेगा ।

S.O. 541 ( E ) .— Whereas it appears to the Government of the India that it is necessary in public interest that

Pipelines ( Acquisition of Right of User in Land ) Act , 1962 , ( 50 of 1962 ) Government of India hereby declares its

New Delhi , the 2nd February , 2023 

. 

S.O. 498 ( E ) – Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways , S.O. 718 ( E ) dated 16th February 2022 , published in the Gazette of India , Extraordinary , Part II , Section 3 , 
Sub - section ( ii ) issued under sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3A of the National Highway Act , 1956 ( 48 of 1956 ) 
( hereinafter referred to as the said Act ) , the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building Maintenance , management and operation of NH73 on the 
stretch of land from Km 20.150 to Km 40.00 ( B C road to Kottigehara Section ) in the district of DAKSHINA 

KANNADA in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in " Prajavani " and " Deccan Herald " 
both dated 26th February 2022 ; under sub - section ( 3 ) of section 3A of the said Act ; 


and whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority ; 


And whereas , in pursuance of sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government ; 


Now , therefore , upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub - section ( 1 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose ; 


And further , in pursuance of sub - section ( 2 ) of section 3D of the said Act , the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette , the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government , free from all encumbrances .

का . आ . 528 ( अ ) . – जबकि भारत सरकार को लोकहित में यह आवश्यक प्रतीत होता है कि मेघालय राज्य में नार्थ - 
इस्ट नेचुरल गैस पाइपलाइन ग्रिड परियोजना के गुवाहाटी - शिलांग- सिलचर - पानीसागर खंड के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक 
से 
गैस के परिवहन के लिए मैसर्स इंद्रधनुष गैस ग्रिड लिमिटेड द्वारा एक पाइपलाइन बिछाई जानी चाहिए ; 


और भारत सरकार को उक्त पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए यह आवश्यक प्रतीत होता है कि उस भूमि में , 
जिसमे उक्त पाइपलाइन बिछाए जाने का प्रस्ताव है और जो इस अधिसूचना में संलग्न अनुसूची में वर्णित है , उपयोग के 
अधिकार का अर्जन किया जाए ; 


अतः अब , भारत सरकार , पेट्रोलियम और खनिज पाइपलाइन ( भूमि मे उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन ) 
अधिनियम , 1962 ( 1962 का 50 ) कि धारा 3 की उपधारा ( 1 ) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए , उस भूमि में 
उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है ; 


कोई व्यक्ति , जो उक्त अनुसूची में वर्णित भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उस तारिख से जिसको उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 
की उपधारा ( 1 ) के अधीन भारत के राजपत्र में यथा - प्रकाशित इस अधिसूचना की प्रतियों साधारण जनता को उपलब्ध कर 
दी जाती हैं , 21 दिन के भीतर , भूमि के नीचे पाइपलाइन बिछाए जाने की संबंध में , सक्षम प्राधिकारी , मैसर्स इंद्रधनुष गैस 
ग्रिड लिमिटेड , मेघालय राज्य , को लिखित रूप में आक्षेप भेज सकेगा ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 2nd February, 2023 


S.O. 513(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH6 in the 
stretch of land from Km 0 to Km50 (Treasury Square, Aizawl, Mizoram) in the district of AIZAWL in the state of 
MIZORAM, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Additional Deputy 
Commissioner in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

अनुसूची में दिया गया है , ऐसी भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है । 


कोई भी व्यक्ति , जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है , उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 1 ) के अधीन पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए ऐसी भूमि के उपयोग पर राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से इक्कीस दिन के भीतर अपनी 
आपत्ति प्रकट कर सकेगा । 


ऐसी प्रत्येक आपत्ति सक्षम प्राधिकारी , अर्थात् सहायक आयुक्त अनुमंडल कलबुर्गी को लिखित रूप मे प्रस्तुत की 
जाएगी और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी , आपत्तिकर्ता को व्यक्तिगत रूप मे या किसी 
विधिक पेशेवर द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसी आपत्तियों की सुनवाई के पश्चात् तथा ऐसी और जाँच करने के 
पश्चात् , यदि कोई हो , जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे , आदेश द्वारा या तो आपत्तियों को अनुज्ञात कर सकेगा या 
अननुज्ञात कर सकेगा । 


उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3 ग की उप - धारा ( 2 ) के अधीन सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा किया गया कोई भी आदेश 
अंतिम होगा ।

अनुरक्षण , प्रबन्धन और प्रचालन के लोक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि अपेक्षित है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसूची में दिया

land.

notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section () of
